Maps API key missing.

Add this line to local.properties in the project root, then rebuild and reinstall:

MAPS_API_KEY=your Google Maps SDK for Android key

That value is copied into the manifest as com.google.android.geo.API_KEY. An empty key makes Play services fail with a broker error instead of showing the map. Do not commit the key.
The Maps key in the manifest was not replaced. Set MAPS_API_KEY in local.properties or the environment, then rebuild and reinstall.
Google Maps could not start for %1$s. Confirm MAPS_API_KEY in local.properties is a Maps SDK for Android key for this package, then rebuild.
